topic: Why Jets Still Use 1980s Floppy Disks
caption:
📰 Why Jets Still Use 1980s Floppy Disks

Certified avionics remain locked to 3.5-inch floppy disks due to FAA re-certification costs and timelines. Airlines sustain obsolete supply chains while modern storage alternatives face decade-long approval barriers.

📅 13 Oct 2026 | Source: FAA Avionics Certification & Aviation Security Audits
